effect.minecraft.speed.desc: Increases movement speed. Common from role skills and splash potions.
effect.minecraft.slowness.desc: Reduces movement speed. This game treats each level as about -20%; Slowness VI stops you completely.
effect.minecraft.haste.desc: Speeds up mining and attacking. Rarely a core kill tool here.
effect.minecraft.strength.desc: Increases melee damage. Most kills still use special weapons.
effect.minecraft.instant_health.desc: Instantly restores health. Most modes here do not use vanilla healing.
effect.minecraft.jump_boost.desc: Increases jump height. Some shop splash potions apply this.
effect.minecraft.nausea.desc: Warps the screen and makes aiming harder.
effect.minecraft.regeneration.desc: Regenerates health over time. Most modes here ignore vanilla regen.
effect.minecraft.resistance.desc: Reduces incoming damage. Some roles or modes apply it briefly.
effect.minecraft.fire_resistance.desc: Immunity to fire and lava damage.
effect.minecraft.invisibility.desc: Turns you invisible. True-skin, wallhacks, or some roles may still see you.
effect.minecraft.blindness.desc: Near-black vision except at very close range. Different from this mod's blind-vision or darkness.
effect.minecraft.night_vision.desc: See clearly in the dark. Helps against darkness, not blindness.
effect.minecraft.hunger.desc: Drains hunger faster. This game usually ignores vanilla hunger.
effect.minecraft.poison.desc: Vanilla poison: damage over time, cannot kill. Most poisoner/alchemist poison uses a separate system.
effect.minecraft.wither.desc: Damage over time that can kill.
effect.minecraft.absorption.desc: Extra yellow absorption hearts. This game also has its own shield stacks.
effect.minecraft.glowing.desc: Highlights your outline through walls. Often used to expose a position.
effect.minecraft.levitation.desc: Lifts you upward so you cannot walk normally.
effect.minecraft.luck.desc: Vanilla luck. Shops and loot here usually ignore it.
effect.minecraft.unluck.desc: Vanilla bad luck. Usually unused here.
effect.minecraft.slow_falling.desc: Slows falling and reduces fall damage.
effect.minecraft.bad_omen.desc: Can start a village raid. Train maps usually have none.
effect.minecraft.hero_of_the_village.des: Village trade discount after a raid. Usually unused here.
effect.minecraft.darkness.desc: Pulses the screen darker but you can still see nearby. Used by blackouts and some roles.
effect.minecraft.wind_charged.desc: Creates a wind burst on death. Limited impact on the train.
effect.minecraft.infested.desc: Chance to spawn silverfish when hurt.
effect.noellesroles.shop_banned.desc: Blocks opening or buying from the shop.
effect.noellesroles.cca_freezed.desc: Freezes role/CCA ticking so many passives and timers pause.
effect.noellesroles.skill_freezed.desc: Freezes role ticks and blocks skill use. Meetings often apply this.
effect.noellesroles.skill_baned.desc: Blocks skill use without always freezing cooldown ticks.
effect.noellesroles.true_skin.desc: Forces your real skin; disguise/skin swap is ignored.
effect.noellesroles.true_skin_observer.d: You see everyone else's true skin, ignoring replacements.
effect.noellesroles.jump_decrease.desc: Lowers jump strength. Higher levels jump even lower.
effect.noellesroles.eat_meat_food.desc: Restricts eating, used with meat-related roles.
effect.noellesroles.next_skill_baned.des: Seals the next skill. Spellbreaker potion applies this.
effect.noellesroles.tarot_assembly.desc: Tarot assembly mark. Can change death checks in a special area.
effect.noellesroles.black_monitor.desc: Black screen overlay, often paired with control/lockdown effects.
effect.noellesroles.ghost_state.desc: Puts you into a ghost state for spirit-related roles.
effect.noellesroles.tripwire_slow.desc: Tripwire snare: multiplies speed by 0.1. Unlike Slowness VI, you can still crawl.
effect.noellesroles.move_baned.desc: Cannot move. Often paired with turn/use seals.
effect.noellesroles.used_baned.desc: Cannot use items or most key binds.
effect.noellesroles.upside_down.desc: Other living entities appear upside down.
effect.noellesroles.puppet_wander.desc: Body walks on its own in random directions, usually with move/turn seals and cliff checks.
effect.noellesroles.time_stop.desc: Time stop: freezes the world and most actions, with a gray filter and lockdown/mute side effects.
effect.noellesroles.no_collide.desc: No collision with players or blocks, depending on how it is applied.
effect.noellesroles.phantom_spirit_revea: Client-only reveal marker for phantom sight. Usually no particles or icon.
effect.noellesroles.swim_pose.desc: Forces a swimming/prone pose so you cannot stand normally.
effect.noellesroles.tomato_sauce.desc: Covers the screen with tomato sauce.
effect.noellesroles.tomato_form.desc: Tomato form marker used for third-person and drop models.
effect.noellesroles.safe_time.desc: Safe window: usually cannot be killed by normal means, often with no-collide.
effect.noellesroles.ghost_curse.desc: Ghost bind: invisibility, no movement, no items, red particles, and safe time.
effect.noellesroles.otherworld_aura.desc: Marks innocents under the otherworld, driving client shaders and scenery.
effect.noellesroles.nostalgist_backworld: Nostalgist otherworld mark: gray filter and hidden held items.
effect.noellesroles.backworld_outline.de: Only players who also have this effect can see each other's outlines.
effect.noellesroles.wraith_dimension.des: Marks being inside the wraith's pain dimension.
effect.noellesroles.footstep_vanish.desc: Others cannot hear your footsteps or see sprint particles.
effect.noellesroles.mood_drain_reduction: Slows natural SAN/mood drain. Higher levels reduce it more.
Mood no longer drops from natural task drain.
effect.noellesroles.mood_regeneration.de: Slowly restores mood. Higher levels heal faster.
effect.noellesroles.invincible.desc: Usually prevents death. A few roles can still pierce it.
effect.noellesroles.infinite_stamina.des: Sprinting costs no stamina unless No Stamina is also present.
effect.noellesroles.stamina_boost.desc: Raises max stamina by about 35% per level.
effect.noellesroles.stamina_recovery.des: Speeds stamina regen while not sprinting by about 75% per level.
effect.noellesroles.low_san_shader_resis: Reduces low-SAN post-process distortion. Higher levels resist more.
effect.noellesroles.player_isolation.des: You cannot see or hear other players.
effect.noellesroles.heavy_metal_voice.de: Lowers voice-chat pitch. Higher levels go deeper.
effect.noellesroles.voice_robot.desc: Robot-like voice that is still mostly understandable.
effect.noellesroles.voice_helmet.desc: Muffled voice, as if through a helmet.
effect.noellesroles.voice_distortion.des: Distorted voice, like a broken radio.
effect.noellesroles.voice_chorus.desc: Chorus: sounds like several of you talking.
effect.noellesroles.voice_stutter.desc: Repeats short audio chunks like a stutter.
effect.noellesroles.skin_masked.desc: Masks or replaces the visible skin.
effect.noellesroles.voice_helium.desc: Helium pitch-up. Higher levels sound thinner.
effect.noellesroles.chat_ban.desc: Your chat messages are hidden from everyone.
effect.noellesroles.disguise.desc: Replaces your skin with a reserved disguise skin for everyone.
effect.noellesroles.mirror_reunion.desc: Screen shake, then blocks collapse inward and later rise back. Client-only.
effect.noellesroles.time_rewind_mark.des: Marker shown while a rewind is happening.
effect.noellesroles.time_rewind_daze.des: Brief temporal stun/filter when Chrono Wraith rewinds.
effect.noellesroles.time_stop_filter.des: Same gray time-stop look, without freezing the world.
effect.noellesroles.eerie_domain.desc: Inside Ghost Eye's domain; killer instinct is blocked.
effect.noellesroles.no_stamina.desc: No stamina for sprinting. Overrides infinite stamina.
effect.noellesroles.domain_mark.desc: Domain mark: 0 Fool meeting, 1 Warlock arena, 2 Adventurer travelogue. Blocks being pulled into another domain.
effect.noellesroles.vision_fog.desc: Thick fog. Level I sees about 2 blocks; each extra level adds about 3.
effect.noellesroles.two_dimensional_came: 2D / 2.5D camera. Amplifier picks facing or top-down. Shows task arrows.
How far the 2D camera sits. Higher levels move farther away.
effect.noellesroles.pointer.desc: Shows a mouse pointer and aims you at what it hits.
effect.noellesroles.hakoniwa_vision.desc: Builds a dollhouse of the current room and cuts blocking faces by camera angle.
effect.noellesroles.tremble.desc: Hands shake; the crosshair drifts. Applied when Nightmare rage sees you.
effect.noellesroles.illiterate.desc: About 20% of drawn text becomes gibberish. A few intro screens stay readable.
effect.noellesroles.blind_vision.desc: The world is black until sound reveals it. Louder sounds reveal farther.
effect.noellesroles.deafness.desc: No game audio, music, or voice chat.
effect.noellesroles.muffled_hearing.desc: Quiet, low-passed audio that is hard to understand.
effect.noellesroles.limp.desc: Limping walk. Higher levels limp harder.
effect.noellesroles.myopia.desc: Distance blur. Higher levels hide far objects more.
effect.noellesroles.hand_tremor.desc: Slight aim shake with knives/guns, strongest just after drawing.
effect.noellesroles.mental_deafness.desc: Mood is treated as full and no longer drains naturally.
effect.noellesroles.cognitive_bias.desc: Other players' skins randomize and names blur like low mood.
effect.noellesroles.missing_lungs.desc: Suffocates after a delay. Level I is about 115s; each level is 5s faster.
effect.noellesroles.aphrenia.desc: Periodically lose control while a fake walk takes over.
effect.noellesroles.motor_dysfunction.de: Chance to trip into a swimming pose while moving.
effect.stupid_express.arsonist_burning.d: Arsonist burn: stay on fire and die when the burn ends.
